options.name: count_mode
options.description: How to determine the count of XPath matches when O(what=count). V(match) evaluates the XPath expression and counts the results with Python's V(len(\)). This is always correct for any XPath expression. V(xpath) uses the XPath V(count(\)) function, which is more memory-efficient for large result sets since it does not build the full list of matches in memory. However, it may produce different results for XPath expressions that do not return node-sets. This option is only used when O(what=count). F

options.name: huge_tree
options.description: Disable libxml2 security restrictions on XML node size or document depth, allowing processing of very large XML files. This option should only be activated when needed, as it disables internal safety limits.

options.name: namespaces
options.description: The namespace C(prefix:uri) mapping for the XPath expression. Needs to be a C(dict), not a C(list) of items.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the file to operate on. This file must exist ahead of time. This parameter is required, unless O(xmlstring) is given.

options.name: strip_cdata_tags
options.description: Remove CDATA tags surrounding text values. Note that this might break your XML file if text values contain characters that could be interpreted as XML.

options.name: what
options.description: Select what kind of information to return for the given O(xpath).

options.name: xmlstring
options.description: A string containing XML on which to operate. This parameter is required, unless O(path) is given.

options.name: xpath
options.description: A valid XPath expression describing the item(s) you want to operate on. Operates on the document root, V(/), by default.
